note: the tie rule the per-question files force on every recomputation, against the frozen analyser's own choice. Ties are the only decisions that can differ, so this bounds the whole effect.

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.winner_id) AS count_left_hand_winners
FROM 
    matches m
JOIN 
    players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id
WHERE 
    m.tourney_name = 'WTA Championships' 
    AND p.hand = 'L'

SELECT cm.Maker, cd.Year
FROM cars_data cd
JOIN car_names cn ON cd.Id = cn.MakeId
JOIN model_list ml ON cn.Make = ml.Model
JOIN car_makers cm ON ml.Maker = cm.Id
WHERE cd.Year = (SELECT MIN(Year) FROM cars_data)

SELECT Make, COUNT(DISTINCT Model) AS ModelCount
FROM car_names
GROUP BY Make
ORDER BY ModelCount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.Make
FROM car_names AS T1
JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.MakeId = T2.Maker
GROUP BY T1.Make
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T2.Model) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T3.Model
FROM car_makers AS T1
INNER JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.Maker
INNER JOIN car_names AS T3 ON T2.ModelId = T3.MakeId
INNER JOIN cars_data AS T4 ON T3.MakeId = T4.Id
WHERE T1.FullName = 'General Motors' OR T4.Weight > 3500

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, m.winner_rank_points
FROM players p
JOIN matches m ON p.player_id = m.winner_id
WHERE m.winner_id = (
  SELECT winner_id
  FROM matches
  GROUP BY winner_id
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT p.first_name || ' ' || p.last_name AS player_name, r.ranking_points
FROM (
    SELECT winner_id, COUNT(*) AS win_count
    FROM matches
    GROUP BY winner_id
    ORDER BY win_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS most_wins
JOIN players p ON most_wins.winner_id = p.player_id
JOIN rankings r ON most_wins.winner_id = r.player_id
ORDER BY r.ranking_points DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name, r.ranking_points
FROM matches m
INNER JOIN players p ON m.winner_id = p.player_id
INNER JOIN rankings r ON p.player_id = r.player_id
GROUP BY m.winner_id
ORDER BY COUNT(m.winner_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    b.name AS battle_name, 
    b.date AS battle_date
FROM 
    ship s
INNER JOIN 
    battle b
ON 
    s.lost_in_battle = b.id
WHERE 
    s.name IN ('Lettice', 'HMS Atalanta')
GROUP BY 
    b.id
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.name) = 2

SELECT DISTINCT b.name, b.date
FROM battle b
INNER JOIN ship s ON b.id = s.lost_in_battle
WHERE s.name IN ('Lettice', 'HMS Atalanta')
GROUP BY b.id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.name) = 2

SELECT AVG(GNP), SUM(Population)
FROM country
WHERE GovernmentForm LIKE '%Territory of the United States%'

SELECT 
    c.Name AS Country, 
    cl.Language AS TopLanguage, 
    cl.Percentage AS Percentage
FROM 
    country AS c
INNER JOIN 
    countrylanguage AS cl
ON 
    c.Code = cl.CountryCode
WHERE 
    cl.Percentage = (
        SELECT MAX(Percentage)
        FROM countrylanguage AS cl2
        WHERE cl2.CountryCode = cl.CountryCode
    )

SELECT Language
FROM (
  SELECT CountryCode, Language, Percentage,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CountryCode ORDER BY Percentage DESC) AS rn
  FROM countrylanguage
)
WHERE rn = 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CountryCode) AS TotalCountries
FROM countrylanguage AS T1
WHERE T1.Language = 'Spanish'
  AND T1.Percentage = (
    SELECT MAX(T2.Percentage)
    FROM countrylanguage AS T2
    WHERE T2.CountryCode = T1.CountryCode
      AND T2.Language = 'Spanish'
  )

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM Professionals T1
INNER JOIN Treatments T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id
WHERE T2.cost_of_treatment < (SELECT AVG(cost_of_treatment) FROM Treatments)

SELECT 
    O.last_name
FROM 
    Owners O
JOIN 
    Dogs D ON O.owner_id = D.owner_id
ORDER BY 
    D.date_of_birth DESC
LIMIT 1
